rationale: The candidate reads as one compact mass, but the section logic is too abstract and the stepped/terraced roof articulation does not convincingly communicate a usable long-span gym hall. Across views it remains coherent enough as a single object, yet it behaves more like a faceted sculptural block than a hall with subordinate service and a clear public threshold. The access edge is not expressed by a meaningful void or undercut, so the thick blue frontage does not receive a legible ground response. The dominant gesture is present, but the open-space figure is weak and the silhouette relies on arbitrary diagonal facets rather than a roof spanning or daylighting logic. As early-stage massing, it is structurally intact, but program-fit fails because the visible roof/section does not support the gymnasium invariant of clear span plus clear public entry hierarchy.
